variants.headline: Looking back: building finished and handed over
variants.sub: The project {project} has been completed and handed over by {builder}.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: The builder {builder} had finished and handed over {project}.

A handover deserves attention to the work behind it, not only the name attached to the project. Labour should recognise a completed undertaking while remembering that a building's purpose concerns people. The achievement should not make those who build or those expected to use it disappear from the account.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We remain critical of {target}. A completed building should not place overall stewardship beyond scrutiny, or turn a particular delivery into automatic approval of every judgment surrounding the project and its purpose.
